summary: Thin forwarder with no local computation: it unconditionally tail-jumps to 0x58DC60, so any arguments and any floating-point state (for example the x87 stack) pass through untouched. Two callers reach it (sub_588212 and sub_58DD89), suggesting a shared CRT-style float helper whose real body lives at the jump target.

operations.description: Unconditional tail jump to 0x58DC60; control transfers without a return, forwarding the current argument and FPU state.

unresolved: The real implementation at the jump target 0x58DC60 is outside this packet, so the actual float operation performed is unknown.
The argument-passing convention (likely x87 st0 based on the ABI hint) is not proven by call-site evidence here.
Why both sub_588212 and sub_58DD89 route through this wrapper instead of calling the target directly is not explained.
